title: database lock
content: Symptoms: transaction waiting on lock; blocking_pid=412. Investigation: Inspect the blocking transaction; ask the database owner before cancelling it.

title: upstream timeout
content: Symptoms: upstream request deadline exceeded; dependency=bank. Investigation: Check dependency health and retry budgets; avoid a retry storm.

title: connection pool exhausted
content: Symptoms: connection pool exhausted; active=20 max=20. Investigation: Inspect long-running queries and connection leaks before changing pool limits.

title: disk full
content: Symptoms: write failed: no space left on device; usage_pct=99. Investigation: Inspect disk usage and approved retention policies; do not delete files automatically.

title: bad deployment
content: Symptoms: startup failed: missing required configuration PAYMENT_REGION. Investigation: Compare deployment configuration with the last healthy version; propose an approved rollback.

title: healthy
content: Symptoms: request completed; status=200; latency_ms=42. Investigation: Observe service metrics; no corrective write is indicated by this snapshot.
